description: My name is Ailany Callejas and I'm passionate about astronomy. This is my first time participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, and I want you to join me on this adventure along with NOVA and my siblings.
summary: In this interactive project, our astronaut robot travels to the Moon in search of NASA Abandoned but not Forgotten equipment, bringing its remarkable work back to life. Through fun and engaging gameplay, we will teach children and teenagers while keeping them entertained!
details:
Nova's Space Mission

The space game Nova's Mission was developed using Scracht, a user-friendly online platform where children our age can take their first steps into the world of programming and begin exploring this exciting field. Our main goal is to present our ideas creatively and include relevant scientific facts to educate our generation and encourage others to keep learning about these topics.

Trough this game, we can learn about the equipment that has successfully completed its mission and provided us with valuable information about the Moon, as well as samples for scientific research, such as lunar rocks and soil. We can discover this information by completing the challenge: clicking on the falling stars. Once we complete it, we unlock the information window where we can learn more about our friends on the Moon.

Technology Used

Developed using Scracht 3.0, a visual, block-based programming language created by MIT, designed to develop interactive stories, animations and games.

Canva: Background design and visual scene creation.

AI Tools: Assistance in creating and enhancing visual elements and illustrations.

AI-Assistes Translation: ChatGPT was used to assist with translating text from Spanish into English.

How We Created Our Project

Our team developed the idea for this children's game through a brainstorming session. We started by creating our own hand-drawn illustrations and then brought them to life using CANVA and AI tools. After that, we built all the game scenes from scratch on our Scratch platform.

Our little sister drew Nova and chose the colors for our little robot. We then made Nova the main character of our Scratch game. Next, we transformed the equipment into cartoon-style characters, adding a touch of realism so that each one could be seen more clearly.

We also created the story, the, texts, and the gameplay, based on the first phase of our game. We hope to continue developing a second phase set on Mars, which could become our next adventure!

Our Experience

This is our first time participating in this amazing project, and it has been a wonderful adventure! We hope you enjoy playing our game as much as we enjoyed creating it and taking on this challenge.
